description: This file defines data structures and methods related to Raft log entries and log slices, including identification, validation, and properties of log entries within the Raft consensus algorithm.

classes.name: entryID
classes.description: Struct representing a unique identifier for a Raft log entry, consisting of a term and index.

classes.name: logSlice
classes.description: Struct representing a contiguous slice of Raft log entries, including methods for validation and retrieving last entry information.

methods.name: pbEntryID
methods.description: Returns the entryID corresponding to a given pb.Entry.

methods.name: lastIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the last entry in the log slice.

methods.name: lastEntryID
methods.description: Returns the ID of the last entry in the log slice.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the logSlice is well-formed according to Raft safety properties.
